title.narrative: Multi Donor Trust Fund for the Pacific Region Infrastructure Facility

description.narrative:
"The Pacific Regional Infrastructure Facility is a multi-donor partnership established to provide flexible, transparent long-term support and increased infrastructure investment in Pacific Island Countries. This TFP represents interim funding arrangements for funds administered by the World Bank. In parallel, AusAID is also establishing a separate Infrastructure Facility administered by ADB. These Facilities will be administered separately but with common mechanisms to ensure effective coordination.
During this interim phase, a longer-term PRIF funding and delivery mechanism will be developed, with the interim process providing the development partners an opportunity to strengthen coordination and harmonization, as well as undertake core analytic work to define a long-term strategic direction.
PRIF has five overall strategic objectives: 1. Strengthen infrastructure services through the provision of long-term, performance-linked support. 2. Support country and region-led mechanisms, including infrastructure planning and management and enhanced country/regional ownership. 3. Support public expenditure management, by assisting with improved budgetary management and planning/funding of infrastructure services. 4. Build technical and institutional capacity to manage infrastructure, with a focus on approaches suitable for small island states. 5. Improve partnership and harmonization, by providing a common platform for collaboration in infrastructure in the Pacific."
